schema_version: 1
layers:
  domain: internal/domain
  use_cases: internal/usecase
  inbound_http: internal/transport/http
  outbound_postgres: internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres
  outbound_events: internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats
  outbound_services: [internal/infrastructure/http/taskanswer, internal/infrastructure/filestorage]
  composition_root: cmd/mc-course-service/main.go
invariants:
  - internal/transport direct children are fail-closed to http, message, cli, websocket, and common
  - internal/transport/http direct children are fail-closed to api, admin, and private
  - transport is inbound-only; concrete outbound HTTP clients are owned by infrastructure and forbidden under transport and adapters
  - API, admin, and private routers import only handlers owned by their contour
  - infrastructure is outbound-only and fail-closed to persistence/postgres, messaging/nats, http/taskanswer, and filestorage
  - internal/adapters is forbidden and must be absent
  - domain and usecase do not import transport, infrastructure, or framework implementations
  - the composition root independently wires all HTTP contours and outbound implementations
  - handlers parse and serialize; use cases own behavior; repositories own persistence
  - reusable content entities and ordered hierarchy relations remain distinct
  - public reads apply active-state navigation plus inherited lesson read-access policy
  - ADMIN and MODERATOR may mutate; TEACHER may read administrative content
  - assessment task data is stored in task_test tables and must match its task type
  - deprecated knowledge-import compatibility preserves source keys, deterministic identity, ownership scope, and transaction boundaries; Practice v2 never invokes it
  - events follow committed database changes and are not a substitute for database truth
  - lazy practice material remains an ordinary complete private Course hierarchy and never stores student route state
  - generated Course transport and domain processing share one 16 MiB serialized document limit
cross_service_contracts:
  - ms-go-student owns task progress consumed by course deletion/content rules
  - ms-go-filestorage owns uploaded objects referenced by task_filestorage
  - validator and sandbox consumers interpret code_structure, capabilities, compose config, and starter files
